facts.claim: Project .codex/ layers (config.toml, hooks, rules) load only when the project is trusted; untrusted projects ignore them; project config cannot override openai_base_url, chatgpt_base_url, model_provider(s), notify, profile(s), otel and similar.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Non-managed hooks must be reviewed and trusted (hash-recorded) before running; --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust bypasses for one invocation; requirements.toml allow_managed_hooks_only ignores user/project/session hooks.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2025-61260 / GHSA-xrxf-jgv3-qmrm: Codex CLI <= 0.23.0 automatically loaded project-local .env and .codex/config.toml (MCP servers) without confirmation, allowing command execution on running codex in a malicious repo (GHSA published 2026-04-14; Check Point research).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D04.rationale: Project .codex layers and hooks are ignored until the project is trusted and hooks need hash-based review; the earlier CVE-2025-61260 shows past gaps and headless trust behaviour is not verified.
